The **De-shuttering Permit** is the formal site-level authorization. Before any formwork strip: 1\. Site engineer verifies concrete age vs minimum stripping time 2\. Cube test results reviewed (if early stripping requested) 3\. Backpropping arrangement verified 4\. PMC + structural consultant signature obtained 5\. Permit issued; only then crew authorized to strip Without permit discipline, individual workers / supervisors strip on judgement; collapse incidents result. For multi-storey buildings + cantilevers, mandatory permit prevents 100% of premature-stripping incidents. #### Standard de-shuttering permit **Permit content**: \- Project + member reference (Column C-15 / Slab S-4 / Beam B-12) \- Concrete grade + ambient temperature \- Pour date + age in days at proposed stripping \- IS 456 minimum stripping time per element (cross-reference table) \- Cube test reference + 7-day / 28-day strength results \- Backpropping plan for multi-storey works \- Approval: site engineer + PMC + (for cantilevers) structural consultant \- Strip date + crew supervisor + sign-off **IS 456 minimum stripping times** (15°C+ ambient, OPC concrete): \- Vertical formwork (column, wall, beam side): 16-24 hours \- Slab soffit (props left): 3 days \- Beam soffit (props left): 7 days \- Slab props (≤ 4.5 m span): 7 days \- Beam props (≤ 6 m span): 14 days \- Cantilever soffit + supports: 28 days **For early stripping**: cube test must show ≥ 70% of design strength + structural consultant approval. #### Common de-shuttering failures 1\. **Premature stripping** — formwork removed before IS 456 minimum age; cracking + deflection. 2\. **No cube test for early stripping** — assumption of strength without verification. 3\. **No backpropping** — slab stripped while floor above is being poured; excessive deflection. 4\. **Cantilever stripped early** — most catastrophic failure mode; minimum 28 days for cantilevers absolute. 5\. **Cold weather not compensated** — winter pour stripped per summer schedule; strength inadequate. 6\. **PPC concrete treated as OPC** — PPC needs longer curing + stripping time. 7\. **No engineer sign-off** — strip decision left to crew foreman; no accountability. 8\. **Visual inspection only** — no measurement of deflection / cracking immediately post-strip. #### Cross-references **Companion formats**: \- [Formwork Removal Schedule (FMT-SIT-024)](https://infralens.in/formats/site-execution/FMT-SIT-024_Formwork_Removal_Schedule) — schedule planning \- [Daily Concrete Pour Register (FMT-SIT-015)](https://infralens.in/formats/site-execution/FMT-SIT-015_Daily_Concrete_Pour_Register) — pour records \- [Curing Register (FMT-SIT-025)](https://infralens.in/formats/site-execution/FMT-SIT-025_Curing_Register) — curing duration \- Cube test register (cross-reference) **Codes**: \- **IS 456:2000** — RCC code; Clause 11.3 (formwork) \- **IS 14687:1999** — Falsework for Concrete Structures \- **IS 4990:2011** — Plywood for Concrete Shuttering \- **IS 516 Part 1 Sec 1:2021** — Cube compressive strength ### More related 📐IS / IRC codes - [IS 456](https://infralens.in/code/IS-456) ✏️Design rules - [Minimum Ceiling Height Residential](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/minimum-ceiling-height-residential) - [Minimum Mezzanine Clear Height](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/minimum-mezzanine-clear-height) 📘Handbook topics - [Column Load Capacity Tables](https://infralens.in/handbook/column-capacity) - [Development Length & Lap Length](https://infralens.in/handbook/development-length) - [Concrete Cover Requirements](https://infralens.in/handbook/concrete-cover) 🔧Calculators - [rcc-design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Related Formats — Site Execution - 📐 [Bar Bending Schedule (BBS) — Beam\\ \\ schedule · FMT-SIT-001](https://infralens.in/formats/site-execution/bar-bending-schedule-bbs-beam) - 📐 [Bar Bending Schedule (BBS) — Column\\ \\ schedule · FMT-SIT-002](https://infralens.in/formats/site-execution/bar-bending-schedule-bbs-column) - 📐 [Bar Bending Schedule (BBS) — Slab\\ \\ schedule · FMT-SIT-003](https://infralens.in/formats/site-execution/bar-bending-schedule-bbs-slab) - 📐 [Bar Bending Schedule (BBS) — Footing\\ \\ schedule · FMT-SIT-004](https://infralens.in/formats/site-execution/bar-bending-schedule-bbs-footing) - 📐 [Bar Bending Schedule (BBS) — Pile / Pile Cap\\ \\ schedule · FMT-SIT-005](https://infralens.in/formats/site-execution/bar-bending-schedule-bbs-pile-pile-cap) - 📋 [Level Book Format\\ \\ register · FMT-SIT-006](https://infralens.in/formats/site-execution/level-book-format)
